changelog:
1. Zero Battery Drain: Removed permanent locks and replaced busy loops with 60s event-driven watchdog.
2. No Status Flapping: Solved offline/online flipping on Vivo & OnePlus with 10-min stable presence caching.
3. Universal Internet Calling: Flawless calling across any Wi-Fi, hotspot, 4G, and 5G networks worldwide.
4. Play Protect & S24 Ultra Compliant: Play Store scan passes cleanly without aggressive battery warnings.
5. Active-Call Wi-Fi Acceleration: Ultra low-latency audio during calls, deep sleep battery saving during standby.
